cells.detail: Partior demonstrates synchronized movement of commercial-bank-money claims across participating banks and currencies.

sources.label: Partior and LSEG DiSH settlement-liquidity collaboration

cells.text: Participating-bank deposit liabilities on a shared network
cells.note: Role in the SEC order: supporting layer

cells.text: Partior and LSEG Digital Settlement House announced a September 17 collaboration intended to supply always-on settlement-bank liquidity across participating banks.
cells.detail: Where the proof stops: Strategic collaboration and intended liquidity movement are not a production integration, named transaction or removal of bank-liability boundaries.

items: Post-trade completion · Cash settlement, Reconciliation + remedy: The network coordinates bank-money settlement while each bank retains its liability.
Interoperability + services · Messaging / bridge, API / integration, Failure authority: Multi-bank orchestration is its core relevance to an external trading venue.

cells.text: The network does not become the obligor for every represented deposit, a U.S. TSV, a public permissionless ledger or central-bank money.
cells.note: Watch: Named banks, currency, account claims, transaction completion, customer credit, default rules and any direct TSV connection.
